title: “Come tomorrow,” she said
goal: Quote what someone said with diýmek, and use aýtmak, soramak and jogap bermek.

intro.text: *Diýmek* follows a quote: *“Men gijä galdym” diýdi*, he said, “I'm late.” Name the speaker first with a colon: *Ol maňa: “Ertir gel” diýdi*. *Aýtmak* tells something to someone: *Ol maňa hakykaty aýtdy*, she told me the truth.

vocab.en: to answer (with the dative: soraga jogap bermek)
question (soragy: the question, as an object)

exercises.question: How do you quote him: **“I'm late,” he said**?

why.1: Inside the quote, keep his own words: *Men gijä galdym*, I'm late.
why.2: After a quote, the verb is *diýdi*. *Aýtmak* takes what is said as an object.

exercises.explain: Quote first, then *diýdi*, with no comma between them.
After a quote, *diýdi*. *Aýtmak* takes what is said as an object (*hakykaty aýtdy*), and *sorady* is for questions.

reject.why: Inside the quote, keep his own words: *Men ýadaw*, I'm tired.
Without an ending, **I am** needs its subject: *Men ýadaw*.

exercises.explain: His exact words in quotation marks, then *diýdi*. The *men* inside the quote is the speaker.

accept: My mother asked, “Where are you going?”
My [mother|mum|mom] asked where I was going

exercises.question: What does *Bu söz näme diýmek?* mean?
options: How do you say this word?

why.1: **Who said it** would be *Bu sözi kim aýtdy?*
why.2: **How do you say it** asks how, *nädip*: *Bu söz nädip aýdylýar?*

exercises.explain: *Diýmek* also means **to mean**: *Bu söz näme diýmek?*, what does this word mean?

exercises.label: *diýmek* (to say), present: I say, you say…
exercises.explain: *diý-* + *-ýär*: two *ý* in a row, one from the stem and one from the suffix.

reject.why: The person told takes the dative: *maňa*.

exercises.explain: *aýtmak*: what is said is the object (*hakykaty*), the person told is in the dative (*maňa*).

accept: The teacher said to open [our|your|the] books
The teacher told [us|you|them] to open [our|your|their|the] books

exercises.question: How do you say **Ask the teacher!**?

why.1: With *soramak*, the person you ask takes the ablative: *mugallymdan*.
why.2: With *soramak*, the person you ask takes the ablative: *mugallymdan*. The accusative is for what you ask: *Sebäbini sora*.

exercises.explain: *söz* + *-üň* (of the word) + *manysy* (its meaning): what is this word's meaning? *Bu söz näme diýmek?* says the same.
